_comment: Minimal single-network repro: dronet ONLY, non-periodic (single pass), through the XPU-RT scheduler + xpurt_demo combined-binary runtime on spike. Same purpose as networks_mlp_only_spike.json but for dronet -- isolates whether dronet's ~16x actual-vs-predicted instruction-count gap (seen in the 3-network schedule) persists with no other network present to alias buffers with.
